title: Reported Questions
description: Learn to report questions using indirect speech

explain.ta: Questions-ஐ report செய்யும்போது சில மாற்றங்கள் நடக்கும். Yes/No questions-க்கு 'if' அல்லது 'whether' பயன்படுத்துகிறோம். Wh-questions-க்கு wh-word-ஐ வைத்துக்கொள்கிறோம். Question mark இல்லை, word order மாறும் (subject + verb). Tense backshift நடக்கும். Direct: 'Where do you live?' → Reported: 'She asked where I lived'. Direct: 'Do you like tea?' → Reported: 'He asked if I liked tea'. Auxiliary verbs (do/does/did) மறைந்துவிடும்.
explain.en: When reporting questions, several changes occur. For Yes/No questions, we use 'if' or 'whether'. For Wh-questions, we keep the wh-word. There's no question mark, and word order changes to statement form (subject + verb). Tense backshift applies. Direct: 'Where do you live?' → Reported: 'She asked where I lived'. Direct: 'Do you like tea?' → Reported: 'He asked if I liked tea'. Auxiliary verbs (do/does/did) disappear in reported questions.

examples: 'Do you like it?' → He asked if I liked it
'Are you coming?' → She asked if I was coming
'Can you help?' → He asked if I could help
'Where do you live?' → She asked where I lived
'Where is he?' → He asked where he was
'Where did you go?' → She asked where I had gone
'What do you want?' → He asked what I wanted
'Who is she?' → She asked who she was
'What did you say?' → He asked what I had said
'When will you come?' → She asked when I would come
'Why are you late?' → He asked why I was late
'How do you know?' → She asked how I knew

examples.en: Direct: 'Where do you live?' Reported: She asked where I lived.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நீங்கள் எங்கே வசிக்கிறீர்கள்?' மறைமுக: அவள் நான் எங்கே வசிக்கிறேன் என்று கேட்டாள்.

examples.en: Direct: 'Do you like coffee?' Reported: He asked if I liked coffee.

examples.en: Direct: 'Are you coming to the party?' Reported: He asked if I was coming to the party.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நீங்கள் விழாவுக்கு வருகிறீர்களா?' மறைமுக: அவர் நான் விழாவுக்கு வருகிறேனா என்று கேட்டார்.

examples.en: Direct: 'When will you finish?' Reported: She asked when I would finish.

examples.en: Direct: 'Why are you late?' Reported: He asked why I was late.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நீங்கள் ஏன் தாமதமாக வந்தீர்கள்?' மறைமுக: அவர் நான் ஏன் தாமதமாக வந்தேன் என்று கேட்டார்.

examples.en: Direct: 'How do you know?' Reported: She asked how I knew.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'உங்களுக்கு எப்படி தெரியும்?' மறைமுக: அவள் எனக்கு எப்படி தெரியும் என்று கேட்டாள்.

examples.en: Direct: 'Can you help me?' Reported: He asked if I could help him.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நீங்கள் எனக்கு உதவ முடியுமா?' மறைமுக: அவர் நான் அவருக்கு உதவ முடியுமா என்று கேட்டார்.

examples.en: Direct: 'Who is that person?' Reported: She asked who that person was.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'அந்த நபர் யார்?' மறைமுக: அவள் அந்த நபர் யார் என்று கேட்டாள்.

listeningQuestions.audioText: She asked if I had seen the movie.
options: She asked if I had seen the movie.
She asked if I have seen the movie.
She asked do I see the movie.

listeningQuestions.audioText: He asked where I was going.
options: He asked where am I going.

He asked where I am going.

listeningQuestions.audioText: They asked what time the meeting would start.

They asked what time the meeting starts.
They asked what time the meeting would start.
